_about: Dock 3-class station + M4D-class quadcopter: generic models built to DJI's published dimensions (not DJI products, not endorsed by DJI). The one source of truth for shapes.py (meshes), geometry.py (kinematics, collision), gen_mjcf.py (MuJoCo) and web_glb.py (web GLB). Metres, degrees, seconds, kg. Dock frame: origin on the ground under the dock centre, +X toward the cover that carries the wind gauge, rain gauge and both dock cameras, -Y = front (e-stop, cable ports, electrical cabinet, RTK module), +Z up. Labels: DJI = DJI spec page / manual text; DWG = measured on DJI's own dimensioned drawings in the installation manual; FIT = solved from DJI numbers or drawings; DERIVED = arithmetic on DJI numbers; MEAS = measured on DJI product images or video (sources._imagery); EST = estimate (UNVERIFIED)

sources._drawings: DWG = DJI's dimensioned orthographic drawings in dji_install: p38 front elevation closed (770 mm dimension), p39 side elevation closed (770/745 mm) and top view open (1760/745 mm); scale from DJI's own dimension lines, about +-2 mm. dji_maint p14: camera, rain gauge and wind gauge placement. dji_install p8, dji_um p25 and p32: overview and pad perspective (shapes, not measured). Only measured numbers are used here; nothing from the documents is copied
sources._imagery: MEAS on DJI product images or video = a dimension read off DJI's own published product imagery through a camera solved from known DJI dimensions (PnP), not a published number; each note gives the residual. No image is included or redistributed
sources._cad: No CAD data is used: every mesh is generated by shapes.py from the numbers in this file. Generic models: no logos, trademarks or third-party artwork

envelope._src: DJI specs: includes the RTK module width (160 mm), wind speed gauge height (145 mm) and mounting brackets (58 mm)

base._bracket_h_src: DJI specs footnote (58 mm); the drawings show a 6 mm flange on top up to the frame band at z 64 mm
base._bracket_src: DWG front (feet X +-130..276 mm, bolt slot near the inner edge) + side (feet Y +124..277 and -120..-276 mm, three vertical slots and a bolt slot each)
base._frame_src: DWG front (band X +-273 mm, z 64-95) and side (Y -281.5/+285.5 mm, five bolts)

bottom_plate._src: DWG front (plate between the feet z 49-62 mm, U-shaped spout at X 0) and side (bar z 42-55 mm, spout under the rear half Y 45-124 mm)

body._end_src: EST: end faces of the lower cabinet (hidden by the covers in every drawing); must clear the end wall's bottom edge when open (it swings in to x 0.2585)
body._y_src: DWG top view open (front face -288, rear +290 mm)
body._top_src: DWG front: the cover cut-out above the cabinet face ends at z 355 mm
body._tray_src: DWG top view open: body/tray edge X +-290, rim X +-279 / Y +-287, inner X +-258 / Y +-267 mm
body._tray_wall_src: MEAS on DJI product images and video (open front view, solved camera 2.4 px rms): the charcoal housing above the cabinet face is a vertical wall from z 335 to 370 mm, a chamfer up and in to the rim at about 400 mm, and a black rubber lip on the front and back rim (top about 415 mm) ending in screws at X +-228 mm. Chamfer set-back EST. At the +-X ends the housing stops at the vertical wall (370 mm), with no chamfer or rim, so the pad blocks' end faces stand clear and the channel is open along X: EST from the station's own camera views (the dock camera sees the block ends above a low dark band; the parked aircraft's camera sees over the end into the open cover)

cutout._src: DWG front: cover front-wall opening over the cabinet face (edges X -241/+241, top z 349, 45-degree corner chamfers 59 mm); rear assumed the same (EST, UNVERIFIED)

end_bay._src: EST: a dark vertical slot in the cabinet's end face around the actuator, a round housing beside it (seen in public footage of the internal camera); sizes scaled from the cabinet's width, depth EST

pad._z_src: MEAS + EST, UNVERIFIED: DJI publishes no pad height. Bounded by the closed covers (aircraft 212.5 mm + props must fit under the roof liner) and fitted to where the parked aircraft shows in DJI product images and video (pad._floor_src)
pad._block_z_src: MEAS on DJI product images and video, UNVERIFIED +-15 mm: outer (front) edge and corner light panels at z 417-425 mm; the crest at 472-475 mm for |X| <= 100 mm, falling to the edge height by |X| 176-200 mm (crest_flat_x, crest_end_x); DJI's 485 mm open height caps it
pad._floor_src: MEAS on DJI product images and video (solved cameras): the blocks are high beside the aircraft body and low under the motors, and the parked aircraft sits deep in the pocket: silhouette fits put the channel floor at 290-330 mm (best 295-305); the far motors hiding behind the front block's crest in a front view needs <= 290 mm, a high front view puts them 25-30 mm higher than 300 mm. Floor 300 mm. Clearances at 300 mm (visual meshes): body and arms 19 mm over the block faces, motor pods 22 mm over the land
pad._plan_src: DWG top view open: channel lines Y +-45, block inner edges +-88, outer +-255 mm, diagonal block corners and triangular positioning-marker light panels at the four corners (dji_maint 5.5: 'light panels of the positioning markers')
pad._arch_src: DWG top view open (dji_install p39, 0.756 mm/px over the pad, line centres per column): each block is a scoop. From the inner edge line (|Y| 89 mm) a concave face rises to the arch line (|Y| 199.6 mm for |X| <= 91 mm, curving down to |Y| 106 mm by |X| 242 mm); a land (the crest) runs from the arch to the lens line |Y| 224 mm in the middle and to the outline diagonal (block_corner) toward the ends; then the outer face falls to the edge height. Face exponent and outer-fall width EST. This puts the crest outboard of the aircraft's arms: the arms pass over the face, the motor pods over the land where it has fallen (|X| 171 mm)
pad._marker_src: DWG top view: aircraft orientation marker (H with a triangle toward +X) in the channel centre (dji_install p8 part 8)

cover._box_src: DWG front (X +-318..320, cover bottom edge 95 mm on the frame band, parting line X -33 mm) and side (Y -301/+303 mm, bottom 94-96 mm)
cover._roof_src: DWG front: roof 608 mm at X +-295 rising to 642-643 at the ridge (X 0); side: 643 mm at Y 0-150 falling to 636 at Y +-275 (crown = 0.48*(|y|-0.15)^2)
cover._edges_src: DWG side: roof-to-front/back round 619->635 mm over 17 mm; front: roof-to-end chamfer 579->607 mm over 13 mm; front/side: 33 mm vertical corner chamfers (lines at X +-285, Y +-269); top corner facets from the inner lines on both elevations (plane 0.889|x| + 1.167|y| + z = 1.156)
cover._parting_src: DWG front: parting line vertical at X -33 down to z 475, then diagonal to X 0 at z 415; triangular notch over the RTK fin down to z 355

grip._src: DWG front/side: slots on the four vertical corner chamfers

hatches._src: MEAS on a DJI product image of the +X end (solved camera 2.1 px rms, 1.3 px/mm): three outlined access hatches with finger slots, mid one Y -32..32 z 312-357, lower two Y +-190..254 z 97-138 over the hinges. The -X end keeps the DWG side view's recess position (Y 0..70, z 331-377; UNVERIFIED whether the ends differ)

cover._wall_src: EST: double-skin shell. DWG top view open shows ~10 mm front/back walls at the roof; DJI product video shows a thicker dark inner edge on the open covers, so 20 mm
cover._hinge_src: FIT on DWG: the open top view's outer roof lines (right cover ridge X +807 mm, left cover parting crest X -806 mm, stroke-corrected) and DJI's 485 mm open height (the right cover's parting corner) give pivot (0.3075, 0.1440) at 90 deg; both covers' roofs agree to 1 mm. The weather module is drawn 12-19 mm further out in the open view than the closed elevations put it (rain gauge top +13, dock camera +12, cups +19 mm; no single hinge angle fits both the roofs and the module), so our open length comes out ~1.74 m against DJI's 1760: DJI's drawings disagree there, not the hinge.
cover._travel_src: EST, UNVERIFIED: timed on public footage of the station opening (frame-difference motion 1.2 s -> 6.3 s, flat at 5.0-5.3 s). DJI publishes no cover time

actuator._src: DJI drawings (install p8, um p25, top view open): one linear actuator per cover on the centre line, cylinder from the cabinet end bay to a clevis on the cover's end wall (open: X 0.43-0.50). Pin positions EST

gauge._src: DWG front (mast X 214.5-256 mm, collar z 714-724 r 22.5, rotor as wide up to z 746 under a domed cap, cup centres X 235 -/+ 34 and 0, z 749, top 769-770) and side (mast Y 25-67 mm, the cup at -Y seen from behind, the other two at +Y 19 mm): three cups on a 39 mm arm, one pointing -Y (phase 270 deg) is the only layout both elevations show; DJI 145 mm gauge height. Base DWG front (flat top z 630 from X 198 to 267, then a fillet down to the roof at X 278)
gauge._cam_src: DWG side: two discs on the mast's -X face, the lower 23 mm (camera) at z 677, the upper 21 mm (light) at z 699; dji_maint p14 part 1. The open top view draws them 12 mm further out (see cover._hinge_src)

rain_gauge._src: dji_maint p14 part 2 (round plate, six screws) on the gauge cover's roof; DWG front: a level disc, left edge X 128 mm, top z 638-640 (it stands proud of the sloping roof by 10-30 mm). Y, disc and screw circle MEAS on a DJI product image of the top (solved camera on the RTK bolts and roof edges, 1.3 px rms): centre (200, 167.5), ring r 71.5, plate r 50, screws on r 64 mm

rtk._src: DWG side (10 mm grid): puck Y -302..-437 (centre -370.5, r 66), dome top z 367, dark band 341-356, base plate 333, bracket profile (yz polygon above: lower edge from the cabinet face at z 290 up to 313, then to the plate at Y -390); DWG top open: puck r 66 with six bolt heads on a 68 mm circle, mounting block X +-39, but centred Y -378 (6 mm further out than the side view; we follow the side view). DWG front: triangular fin inside the covers' front notch, apex z 410 (notch apex 418)

front_panel._estop_src: MEAS on a DJI product image of the open front, back-projected onto the panel (solved camera, 12 points, 2.4 px rms, 1.15 mm/px): yellow housing X -185..-143.5 z 245..320 mm with rounded corners; red mushroom button centred X -165.6 z 281.7, r 19 mm, in a raised yellow collar
front_panel._door_dwg: DWG front also draws a recessed panel X 34-224 z 157-257 and a latch outline X 138-219 z 162-252 on the door; DJI's images show the latch outline as the grey box behind the window
front_panel._door_src: MEAS on DJI product images of the front, back-projected onto the door plane (855 px/m): the door is a smoked window in a narrow dark frame; behind it a row of DIN-rail breakers X 52-114 z 207-250 mm and a grey box X 132-205 z 182-253 (the DWG latch outline). Depths EST
front_panel._ports_src: MEAS, same image and camera: three cable glands at the top of the port bay (AC in, LAN in, PoE out) at X -194.6/-137.1/-78.5 mm (the drawing's ports_x), black bodies 25 mm wide from z 207 down to 140 mm with a grey latch; a 7 mm cable from each curves down and toward +X, reaching the panel's bottom lip (z 55-59 mm) at X -143.6/-97.5/-46.7 mm, then into the base. Printed port labels above each gland (z 214-228 mm, separators at X -166/-110; plain panels here, no text) and a rating plate X -105..-37.5 z 111..150 mm
front_panel._src: DWG front, measured on a 10 mm grid over the drawing (stroke centres): emergency stop (dji_install p8 part 15) on a 42 x 67 mm base centred X -163 z 287; E-Port plate (part 20) X -139..-45 z 261..312 with two square sockets and an oval; port panel outline with its chamfered corner; AC-IN / LAN-IN / PoE-OUT bay (parts 10, 13, 9) X -236..-24 z 91..207; electrical cabinet door (part 12) X 2..241 z 91..324 with chamfered right corners, a recessed panel, a latch and two bolts. Glands, cables and e-stop details: _ports_src, _estop_src

rear_panel._src: DWG top view open: the cabinet back stands out to Y +298.5 mm over X -240..236 (the covers' rear cut-out); its height assumed to match the cut-out (EST). Its face is plain: no DJI drawing or image shows it

cover_markers._about: Markings on the inner face of the gauge cover's roof (a wall facing the pad once open) and the target plate in the other cover. Wall coordinates: u = Y, v = distance from the parting edge along the roof. Layout from dji_maint p14 and public footage of the parked aircraft's camera; sizes EST, UNVERIFIED

plate._src: dji_install p8 / dji_um p25 top view (rear corner of the open left cover, by its outer end) and DJI product images: a white plate with three dark squares on a 45-degree gusset. EST

dock_internal._src: DJI specs: 1920x1080, 151 deg FOV (diagonal), white auxiliary light. dji_maint p14: on the inner face of the gauge cover's roof, above the H marker; when open the roof is a wall and the camera looks across the pad. Position along the roof EST

stream._src: FIT on public footage of the livestream (covers open): straight horizon and straight wall edges, so the stream is dewarped; the cabinet's 578.5 mm end face spans 191.5 of 557 px from the modelled camera (0.516 m away), giving 117 deg horizontal. UNVERIFIED (one frame)

dock_external._src: DJI specs (as above). Position DWG (gauge.ext_cam_z, on the mast's -X face); dji_install: 'the dock camera on the wind speed gauge module'. Closed it looks along the roof toward -X; open it looks up

stream._src: assumed the same dewarp as dock_internal (UNVERIFIED)

drone.name: M4D-class quadcopter
drone._mass_src: DJI specs (1850 g incl. battery, propellers, microSD; MTOM 2090 g, dji_um 6.7)
drone._lwh_src: DJI specs (without propellers); with propellers dji_um 6.7 'Maximum Dimensions'
drone._wb_src: DJI specs: diagonal 498.5, front motors left-right 383.0, rear 343.0, front-rear 341.6 mm
drone._prop_src: DERIVED: (710.3 - 383.0) mm = 327.3 from the with/without-prop widths; lengths give 325.0. Model 1364F (DJI), folding
drone._pod_src: DERIVED: L 377.7 - 341.6 and W 416.2 - 383.0 (motor pods set the length and width)
drone._nose_src: EST (public footage of the parked aircraft's camera): parked, the wide camera looks at the gauge cover's H wall
drone.shape_src: MEAS / EST in 'shape' below; only the numbers above are DJI

shape._src: MEAS by a two-image bundle adjustment on DJI's top-view and front 3/4 product images, both cameras solved with DJI's motor axes as control points (motor tops at 212.5 mm in the top view, prop-clamp tops at 223.2 mm in the 3/4 view); 12 features seen in both images triangulated, 1.15 px rms. A plain scale from the motor spacing would make the body ~5% small (the top image is a near perspective); every plan value here is corrected. EST: the belly (DJI's height puts the lowest point 212.5 mm under the motor tops; the images do not show it), the gimbal's depth, the blade planform

body._cols: x, half width, z bottom, z top (superellipse sections): the upper shell, the part the top photo sees
body._meas: nose tip x 0.1564, tail x -0.0853, waist half width 0.048, top 0.135-0.137 (flat); the shell's lower edge from the front photo (nothing shows beside the gimbal yokes below the forehead)

lower._cols: x, half width, z bottom, z top
lower._src: MEAS bound + EST: in DJI's front image nothing shows outside the gimbal yokes (|y| 41 mm) below the forehead, nor beside the head below the drums, so the lower body is narrower than the shell and its front rises toward the gimbal; DJI product images show a flat belly with a dark block under the gimbal

chin._src: EST: dark ribbed block under the gimbal (DJI product images); hidden behind the gimbal head in the front image

shape._arm_src: MEAS: plan exits and directions (front 32 deg, rear 41 deg off the Y axis), arm-top heights at the fins (front 0.1525, rear 0.163); the exit and pod-end heights follow the measured slopes

arm_root._cols: per station: half width, half height, z offset
arm_root._src: EST fillet sizes; the real rear roots split into a Y that the two images do not pin down (UNVERIFIED)

gnss._src: MEAS: plan centre and radius (top photo), height and rounded top from the front photo (its silhouette top sat ~10 px above ours at 0.1585)

gimbal._meas2: front photo dark-pixel rows: drums from row ~990 to ~1100 and out to |y| 41 mm, head bottom row ~1155 with ~13 mm corner radii
gimbal._src: MEAS in the 3/4 photo on the plane x = face_x (face_x itself EST from the top view's gimbal lip at x 0.163): head z range, face width, drum reach, lens centres and sizes

shape._pod_src: MEAS: pod bottom and bell bottom of the front-right motor in the 3/4 photo; bell top = DJI 212.5

belly._src: EST: dji_um p9 'internal charging modules' on the belly; they touch the pad. Kept behind x 0.045 and inside |y| 30 mm: the front photo shows nothing there

shape._feet_src: collision only: four contact boxes inside the charging pads

prop_fold_deg._src: MEAS on DJI product images and video (front views): parked, the blades of every prop lie along X pointing inboard (front props aft, rear props forward), seen nearly full length from the front (within ~15 deg of X). The 12 deg lean toward the centreline is EST

drone._speed_src: DJI specs, Normal mode (the only mode with a dock)

wide._src: DJI specs, wide camera (the thermal variant: 82 deg, 1/1.3 in 48 MP, 8064x6048)

cameras._fov_note: DJI FOVs are diagonal: 84 deg = 24 mm equivalent on a 43.3 mm diagonal. At 4:3 that is 71.5 deg horizontal, 56.8 deg vertical

ops._close_src: EST: covers close once the drone is 3 m above the pad, clear of the sweep. DJI publishes no number
